dict.string: Daylight reads Time in Daylight from Apple Health to show how many minutes you have spent in daylight today and how that compares with the daylight still available. You choose which sources count.
Daylight does not write anything to Apple Health. It only reads Time in Daylight, and this entry is required because the permission sheet asks about reading and writing together.

Daylight uses your approximate location once to work out today's sunrise and sunset so it can show how much daylight is left. The calculation happens on your device and your location is never sent anywhere.
